summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a positive profit alert for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and a notice of a board meeting. The filing reports expected revenue growth of 28-29% year-over-year, operating profit growth of 113-116%, and net profit growth of 195-200%, driven largely by an unrealized mark-to-market gain from a strategic pre-IPO AI investment. No M&A, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced; this is a routine earnings pre-announcement. There are no deal terms, advisor names, or structural mechanics to analyze. What to watch: the board meeting date for formal earnings release.
